rules.statement: A present Merchant Supplementary Data table uses numeric identifier 049 in Element111 and a three-digit Element112 that counts its Element113 data only, not the six-byte outer table header.

testDesign.notes: Synthetic fragments are not production messages; identifier changes may select other valid tables rather than cause a host rejection.

rules.statement: Table049 data is variable-length alphanumeric data capped at 500 bytes; declared outer length must equal the serialized nested data byte count.

testDesign.positive: Two capability subtables 071Y101Y occupy eight data bytes and declare 008.
testDesign.negative: Change only outer length 008 to 007; review length mismatch.
testDesign.boundary: Isolated length-cap arithmetic: 499 and 500 are not over cap; 501 is over cap.
testDesign.notes: A 500-byte arithmetic payload is not a valid semantic fixture without resolving repetition and unknown-ID policy. Empty present table is unresolved.

rules.statement: Each nested entry has a two-digit numeric ID in 01-99, a one-digit numeric data length in 1-9, and that many alphanumeric data bytes. Table-specific lengths and types narrow this generic envelope.

testDesign.positive: 071Y has ID07, length1 and one data byte.
testDesign.negative: Change only length byte 1 to 0; outside generic permitted length range.
testDesign.boundary: Generic ID endpoints 01/99 and length endpoints1/9; neither implies an undefined layout is supported.
testDesign.notes: Do not apply Table032's three-byte subtable-length format to Table049.

rules.statement: Segment111 carries device-originated variable information with required three-byte segment type and segment length; its length includes the segment type and separators. Separators divide type, length and the variable-information section and follow its final entry, but not table elements or repeated variable-information entries.

testDesign.positive: Independent separator accounting gives 19 bytes for logical 111+019+049004101Y+.
testDesign.negative: Insert only an extra separator between 049 and 004; internal table framing conflicts with section12.10.
testDesign.boundary: Segment maximum999 and repeated variable section maximum991; Table049's own cap remains500.
testDesign.notes: Source deferred/CIT examples use segment length018 for the same-size structure; preserve conflict for review, not as a production fixture.

testDesign.negative: Omit only01 in the same deferred submission; review missing recommended indicator.

testDesign.negative: Change only data M to Y; outside documented code set.

notes.statement: Source is ATL105 release2026-3 dated August07,2026. Line numbers reference docs/specs/extracted_text.txt. Table049 spans Appendix I-39 through I-52; page continuations have been retained as evidence, not separate tables.
The defined nested IDs are01,02,03,04,05,06,07,09,10,11,13,16,17,18,20,21,22,23,24,25,26,27,28,30. Generic01-99 framing does not define missing08,12,14,15,19,29 or later layouts.

All rules are review-only source-grounded constraints for independent TS/TC/TD design, not executable authorizer behavior. Positive inputs are synthetic preconditions; negative cases mutate one target; no source statement guarantees production approval merely because a field is valid.

No general requiredness is inferred for the whole table. Presence rules, code restrictions, network applicability, forwarding gates, defaults and availability are distinct. Undefined absence defaults must not be invented for capability flags.

MasterCard purchase repayment means third-party installment-provider or payment-facilitator installment submissions, including post-purchase/BNPL arrangements. Table049/04=IR has mandatory Table013=I and Table047 provider*retailer dependencies, not an independent guarantee of enrollment or approval.

AppendixZ gives additional COF context: recurring/installment MIT uses02=M and032/08=C; full flows include POS entry mode, recurring/installment markers, prohibited CVV2 and stored original transaction references. Those separate layouts remain dependencies rather than invented Table049 fields.

Request049/18 is Purchase Restriction Method and is distinct from top-level018 Card Acceptor Terminal Identifier Information. Likewise049/13 is installment type, not top-level013 payment marker, and049/21 is not settlement flag021.

Response dependencies are in Segment112 AppendixK:07->030,10->031,11->032,18->034,20->036/037,22->038,26->039,23->042,24->043,25->044,27->045,28->046,30->047. These are response information table identifiers, not ATL105 authorization response codes.

Only-if response gates establish necessary conditions, not universal response presence. Explicit network-response gates exist for10,11,18,20,23,24; other opt-in response layouts must not be strengthened into invented upstream guarantees.

External Conexxus PSPC values, CPoC/software-PIN classification, network program/quality/token rules, merchant-product catalogues and Moneris mappings require separate authority; this batch does not claim external-standard conformance.
